title: The policy of one job of the egress broker (pod-broker), version 1
description: The JSON form of pod_broker::Policy; the TOML form has the same keys. The fixed denies of crates/pod-broker/README.md hold in each mode, and no policy lifts them. A policy that does not agree with this schema is a failure of the class usage (exit 64).

mode.description: allow: only the targets of an allow rule. open: each target that no deny holds; an open policy has no allow rule.

allow.description: The allow rules, in order; the audit names a rule by its index, allow[N].

host.description: A host name (matched in lower case, with no dot at its end), *.NAME (each name below NAME, on whole labels, not NAME itself), an IPv4 address in four decimal parts, or an IPv6 address in brackets.

path.description: A path prefix on whole segments: /v1/repos holds /v1/repos and /v1/repos/x, not /v1/reposx. No dot segment, no empty segment and no escape of a dot or a slash. A tunnel (CONNECT) shows no path: a rule with a path allows a tunnel only when the host gives a TLS end that reads each request.

ports.description: The ports of the rule; none or an empty list: each port. Port 25 is denied in each mode.

deny.description: Extra denies after the fixed ones: a net (ADDR/PREFIX), an address, a name or *.NAME. The audit names an entry policy:deny[N].
